source: &2056 Damn it all.
&1519 Burns all around the planar nodes in his wetware wiring.
target: &1519 湿件线路的平面节点周围全是烧伤。

source: &1520 Yeah...this is our mindjacking victim.
target: &1520 嗯……这是意识劫持的受害者。

source: &2057 Central was right...
target: &2057 中枢说对了……

source: &1521 The attack was recent, maybe minutes ago.
target: &1521 刚遇害不久，也许只有几分钟。

source: &1522 The Mindjacker was probably interrupted by the janitor, who ended up on the street.
target: &1522 意识劫持者大概被清洁工撞见了，清洁工就这么掉到了街上。

source: &2058 There's only one other way out of here - to the roof.
target: &2058 这里还有一条出路，通往楼顶。

source: &2059 We need to get up there, before he escapes again!
target: &2059 得赶紧上去，别让他再逃了！

source: &2060 The Mindjacker was probably interrupted by the janitor.
target: &2060 意识劫持者大概被清洁工撞见了。

source: &2061 Didn't want any witnesses.
target: &2061 他不想留目击者。

source: &1523 He probably didn't mean to send him out the window, either.
target: &1523 他可能也没打算把人扔出窗外。

source: &2062 His ID badge says 'Gerbach, Avery.'
target: &2062 他的工牌上写着“格尔巴赫，艾弗里”。

source: &2063 He's an HR supervisor.
target: &2063 他是人力资源主管。

source: &1524 If the Mindjacker's in corporate espionage, it's a pretty strange target.
target: &1524 如果意识劫持者搞的是商业间谍活动，这个目标可够奇怪的。

source: &2064 Have Central run his data, see if it can flag anything.
target: &2064 让中枢查一下他的资料，看看能不能找出什么。

source: &2065 A roof-access door.
target: &2065 通往楼顶的门。

source: &1525 From the keypad, I'd say it looks like it auto-locks.
target: &1525 看这键盘，应该会自动上锁。

source: &2066 This keypad must be to stop people getting up on the roof.
target: &2066 这个密码键盘应该是用来阻止人上楼顶的。

source: &1526 It's old-fashioned, but effective. Kind of like you.
target: &1526 老派，但管用。有点像你。

source: &2067 Better save that for a last resort.
target: &2067 最好留到万不得已的时候再用。

source: &2068 If it *doesn't* work, we might be stuck.
target: &2068 万一不管用，我们可能就没辙了。

source: &2071 It takes a combination, not a card.
target: &2071 这里要输密码，不能刷卡。

source: &2072 Come on, we've almost caught up with him!
target: &2072 快点，我们就快追上他了！

source: &770 The door to the stairwell has been unlocked - you can feel cold air blowing in from the roof.
target: &770 楼梯间的门已经打开，你能感觉到楼顶吹进来的冷风。

source: &771 The terminals are in standby mode, awaiting their users' return in the morning.
target: &771 终端处于待机状态，等待使用者早晨回来。

source: &772 The terminals have been locked with biometric security.
target: &772 这些终端都用生物识别系统锁住了。

source: &773 The desk phone's projection shows unanswered messages.
target: &773 桌上电话的投影显示着未读留言。

source: &2073 We can't waste time on that now, otherwise we'll lose our tail on the Mindjacker!
target: &2073 现在没时间管这个，不然意识劫持者就跑了！

source: &774 A plaque identifying ownership of the office: "Roy Atwood - HR Operations Manager" - this must be who's in charge of this floor.
target: &774 标牌上写着这间办公室的主人：“罗伊·阿特伍德——人力资源运营经理”。他应该就是这一层的负责人。

source: &775 You have no idea whether these charts mean the company's doing well, or going bust. Amongst all the economics and business-speak, the only word you recognize is 'wetware'.
target: &775 你看不出这些图表到底说明公司经营良好，还是快破产了。那些经济术语和商业行话里，你只认得“湿件”这个词。

source: &776 This terminal is still unlocked, apparently in-use at the time of the attack.
target: &776 这台终端还没锁，遇袭时似乎正有人使用。

source: &777 Apparently, the owner of this cubicle has gone home already.
target: &777 这个隔间的主人显然已经回家了。

source: &778 A cubicle partition, with polarising smart-glass for privacy.
target: &778 办公隔间的隔板，装有偏光智能玻璃，用来保护隐私。

source: &2074 Locked.
&1529 That keypad's probably got something to do with it.
target: &1529 大概跟那个密码键盘有关。

source: Since you just came up yourselves, you can be sure that the Mindjacker hasn't escaped via the elevator.
target: 你们刚从电梯上来，所以可以确定，意识劫持者没有乘电梯逃走。

source: The elevator appears to be the only way into the office.
target: 电梯似乎是进入这间办公室的唯一途径。
